transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, I made the appointment because I just seem to worry about everything right now. It's... it's my clients, the housing market, my family, money. I even stress over whether moving to my condo was the right decision. 

I just feel like my worrying is completely out of proportion to what is actually happening, and I wanted to come in and talk to someone about it.
Do you experience sudden, intense surges of fear or discomfort that peak within a few minutes, or is your anxiety more of a constant, lingering state of worry?

No, I haven't really noticed any sudden, intense surges like that. It's... it's definitely more of a constant thing. Just a lingering worry in the background most of the time, rather than a big spike of fear.
Do you often feel physically tense, such as having tight muscles, restlessness, or difficulty relaxing?

Yes, I do actually. Um, by the end of the day, my neck and shoulders usually feel really tight... kind of like I've been bracing myself all day. And I'll sometimes catch myself just clenching my jaw, especially when I'm driving around between house listings or just sitting at my desk.
Over what period of time have you been experiencing this persistent worrying?
Well, let's see... it's been going on for about a year and two months now. I noticed it really started right after I sold my longtime house and moved into the condo.
Have you been having any difficulty with your sleep, such as trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or feeling like your sleep is restless and unsatisfying?

Yes, I have. Most nights I actually get into bed at a reasonable hour, but my mind just keeps circling. I'll be laying there thinking about the new condo fees, or tomorrow’s showings, or worrying if I missed something in a client's contract. So... it takes me a really long time to finally settle down and fall asleep. And then when my alarm goes off and I wake up, I just feel like I never fully rested.
When you are feeling this way, do you find it difficult to concentrate or does your mind ever go blank?

Yes, I definitely have trouble concentrating. It happens a lot at work. Like, when I'm reviewing purchase agreements or inspection addendums, I'll find myself reading the same paragraph three or four times. A worry will just pop into my head, and I completely lose the thread of what I was checking. It's really frustrating.
Have you noticed that you have been feeling more irritable than usual lately?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean, I get frustrated with myself when I can't focus on my work, like I just mentioned, but I'm not snapping at my clients or my family or anything. So, no, I wouldn't say I've been irritable.
